uniteDbPokemon.notes: Batch-01 mechanics survey used descriptions, true_desc, notes, buffs, cooldowns, levels, and formulas from this public JSON.

passiveEffects.name: Sniper
passiveEffects.originalDescription: When this Pokémon stays near a wall for 1s it becomes camouflaged, making opposing Pokémon unable to target it, and starts gaining critical counters (up to a maximum of 3). A critical counter is gained as soon as Inteleon is camouflaged, with a new counter gained every 3s while camouflaged. Hitting any Pokémon prevents Inteleon from becoming camouflaged for 3s. When a critical counter is consumed, Inteleon's next attack or move that can critically strike is guaranteed to be a critical hit. When this Pokémon stays near a wall for 1s it becomes camouflaged, making opposing Pokémon unable to target it, and starts gaining critical counters. Sobble may only hold one critical counter. Drizzile may hold two. Inteleon may hold three. While camouflaged, Inteleon is slowed by 10%. A critical counter is gained as soon as Inteleon is camouflaged, with a new counter gained every 3s while camouflaged. Dealing or receiving damage breaks the camouflage and prevents Inteleon from starting to camouflage for 3s. When a critical counter is consumed, Inteleon's next attack or move that can critically strike is guaranteed to be a critical hit. Critical hits deal 250% rather than 200% damage.
